attacker_pocs.name: mixed_volume_buffer_size
attacker_pocs.why: The first split volume is a FIFO with a 1024-byte read buffer. The switch transfers that buffer to a regular-file volume, whose read size grows to 65536 bytes. file_read writes beyond the reused allocation through archive_read_open_filenames and archive_read_data.

role_a_rationale: The patch keeps the client read buffer alive across a volume switch, preventing the described use-after-free. It follows the existing file_open/file_close ownership flow and passes the targeted multi-volume tests. The transferred allocation retains the previous volume's capacity while file_open adjusts the next volume's block size, causing a new heap overflow on mixed FIFO and regular-file volumes; the same public-API PoC exits normally on the pinned parent.
